description:
Follow-up to the DONE items ci-lint-parity-pin-2 (WS3) and guards-fix-regen-target-2 (WS5) of _project/planning/ci-failure-reduction-plan.md. PR #2093 (query-template docs) hit three guard failures that fired first in CI, each a full remote round trip, and none reachable from `make ci-lint` / `make pr-preflight` / `make guards-fix`:

1. Adding one Make target (`query-docs`) drifted `make/inventory.json`. `guards-fix` (WS5) regenerates dependency inventory, oracle map, parity fixtures, UAT LOC table, curation list, and skill-sync — but NOT `make/check_makefile_inventory.py --write`. And `makefile-inventory-check` runs only as a pytest (`test_check_makefile_inventory.py`), never as a lint-job step, so the WS3 parity pin (scoped to the pr.yml lint job) does not cover it.
2. `tests/unit/scripts/test_check_release_curation.py:175` asserts the exact string `"Makefile inventory OK: 205 targets, 199 public, default=test"`. Every target addition needs this hand-edited, for zero safety value — the exact count is already verified by `test_check_makefile_inventory.py::test_repository_inventory_matches_manifest`.
3. `scripts/publication/verify_lane_isolation.py` runs only in `.github/workflows/publication-lane-docs.yml`. A build-input script added to `docs/`-adjacent tooling (here `scripts/generate_query_docs.py`) is "unclassified" and fails the site lane check with no local equivalent.

Non-obvious constraints: `verify_lane_isolation` is a diff-vs-base check (needs the PR's changed-file list), so it belongs in `pr-content-guard` (which already computes PATH_LISTS) not `ci-lint` (a current-tree check). Strict-local-vs-CI is acceptable, silent-CI-only is not (the WS3 codespell precedent). `guards-fix` stays operator-only — never wired into CI to self-heal, per its own header comment.

preserves.behavior: Adding a local guard that CI lacks is acceptable (strict-local); a guard that runs only in CI is not.
The exact Make target count stays verified by test_check_makefile_inventory.py::test_repository_inventory_matches_manifest.
ci-lint stays a current-tree check; the diff-vs-base lane check lives in pr-content-guard.
guards-fix stays an operator-only command, never wired into CI to self-heal (its header comment).

verifications.description: guards-fix regenerates the Make inventory when a target is added
ci-lint runs and passes the makefile inventory check
curation + inventory tests pass and the curation assertion is no longer count-brittle

verifications.command: uv run -- python scripts/publication/verify_lane_isolation.py --lane site --changed-paths 'scripts/unclassified_new.py docs/benchmarks/x.md'; test $? -eq 1

verifications.description: the widened ci-lint parity pin passes

work_units.summary: Add check_makefile_inventory.py --write to guards-fix and makefile-inventory-check to ci-lint (with a comment); name guards-fix in the check's failure message; both clean on develop
Replace the exact-count string assertion in test_check_release_curation.py with structural (returncode 0, 'Makefile inventory OK:' and 'public, default=test' in stdout)
Add a lane-isolation-check Make target running verify_lane_isolation.py for site/explorer/corpus against the base diff, and invoke it from pr-content-guard
Widen test_ci_lint_parity.py from the lint job to every merge-gating run: guard (test-job --check guards, publication-lane-docs.yml); each needs a local equivalent or documented exemption
